issue.title: Confirm before deleting a pericope take from Verse mode [Pericope view Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the pericope view audit (#534, epic #526). First seen during PR #550 device QA.

**Severity:** High  
**Launch blocker:** To be decided with product  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local debug build of `ddfdaaa` (PR #559 head), `dev.api.fluent.bible`

## Summary

In Verse mode, a pericope take appears on every verse it covers (#410) and can be deleted from any of them. Deleting it removes the whole multi-verse recording from every verse. `handleDeleteTake` (`src/app/tabs/RecordTab.tsx:687-690`) deletes a non-selected take immediately with no prompt; only the selected take gets the generic "Delete selected take?" alert, which does not mention other verses.

## Expected

Deleting a pericope take from Verse mode asks for confirmation and says the whole recording (vv. X–Y) will be removed.

## Actual

The pericope take is deleted at once, with no confirmation.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Pericope mode: record a take for a pericope (for example, vv. 1–5).
2. On one of its verses, record a verse take so the pericope take is not selected.
3. Switch to Verse mode, open that verse, and delete the pericope take.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Deleting a pericope take from Verse mode shows a confirmation that names the full range.
- [ ] Cancel keeps the take on every verse.
- [ ] Unit test for the confirmation path.
- [ ] Android device QA.

## Related

- Parent audit: #534 (epic #526)
- #410 (pericope takes in Verse mode), PR #550 (original finding)
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/pericope-view/README.md` (PR #583)
